title: Speaking — Seasonal habits
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on seasonal habits.

questions: What did you last use your phone for?
When do you prefer to put your phone away?
Which phone feature do you find especially useful?
Has your phone changed how you arrange to meet people?
Which season changes your routine the most?
Do you buy different kinds of food in different seasons?

part2.topic: Describe an activity you look forward to at a particular time of year.
part2.closing: and explain why the season suits it so well.

questions: How do seasonal changes affect different kinds of work?
Should communities create indoor alternatives for events that depend heavily on the weather?
How has everyday life connected with seasonal habits changed for people of different ages?
